items.alt: A wide, empty hall with a glowing white mandala projected on the far wall. Cane stools, white chairs and standing tables are set out on the carpet.
items.caption: Day 1, before the doors open: the Music Sanctuary hall, empty, with the mandala already glowing on the far wall.
items.credit: Official Devcon 8 photo · The Mandala Room

items.alt: A small band plays in front of a screen showing a mandala: a saxophonist in a white cap and a pink and blue floral shirt, a bass player, and a singer at a microphone.
items.caption: The first sound in the sanctuary area: saxophone, bass and voices, with a mandala on the screen beside them.
items.credit: Official Devcon 8 photo · The Mandala Room

items.alt: A wide shot of a jam session: musicians in the centre on rugs, an audience sitting around them on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, with neon pyramid lights and the mandala above.
items.caption: A full circle: musicians in the middle, and listeners on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, between glowing neon pyramids.
items.credit: Official Devcon 8 photo · The Mandala Room

items.alt: A packed dance floor with hands raised in the haze, light beams, and the mandala projected on the wall above.
items.caption: Hands up in the haze, under the same mandala that watched the empty room on Day 1.
items.credit: Official Devcon 8 photo · The Mandala Room
